name: River-stage pressure and next-week Cairo-Memphis barge freight quotes
original_selection_role: Backup 1; recommended after initial nuclear source access failed. Backup not activated.
economic_hypothesis: Seasonally low Mississippi stage adds incremental information about next-week quoted southbound barge freight beyond recent freight quotes and calendar seasonality.
null: The single low-stage feature does not improve the declared chronological forecast baseline.

sources.name: Mississippi River at Memphis, TN
sources.access_status: Documentation checked; original records not retrieved. New USGS API migration/rights/quota must be checked.

sources.table: Table 9 weekly southbound barge freight rates
sources.units: percent of 1976 tariff, no USD conversion
sources.access_status: Publisher dataset description and original report examples reviewed; full workbook not acquired.

dates.status: Proposed fixed dates; full overlap not verified. Literature already exposed 2022/2023 drought/rate narratives; no held-out/unseen claim.

weekly_join: For each actual USDA quote date t, use observed gage-height days t-6 through t. Preserve quote date, report issue date, raw timestamps, units and quality flags separately. Target is the next scheduled weekly quote; gaps over ten days are unscored, not bridged.
signal: max(0, Q20_calendar_week(2013-2017, week +/-2) - median_gage_height[t-6:t]); feet. Negative gage heights are valid. Require at least 4 observed daily means per weekly measurement and at least 60 climatology daily observations. No alternate threshold or station.
outcome: log(nearby_freight_index[t+1]); positive authentic quotes only, missing/invalid states retained. Physical quote chronology is not publication-time certification.
baseline: Expanding OLS of next-week log quote on intercept, current log quote and one annual sine/cosine pair; initial training through 2020 only. Refit each scored week using only earlier physical-date targets.
augmentation: Same baseline plus one low-stage feature; no interactions or variable search.
primary_metric: Relative reduction in mean absolute log forecast error; also publish errors in the original quote-index units.
support: Report all source weeks, retained weeks, gaps and year counts. Fewer than 100 scored weeks in 2021-2023 is INCONCLUSIVE; no date extension. Weeks are not independent economic events.
diagnostics: Same-week versus next-week association to distinguish contemporaneous pricing from incremental future information.
One fixed 52-week-lagged low-stage feature as a seasonality diagnostic, not an alternative winner.
Year contributions and worst-week influence within the primary analysis, including results with 2022 omitted as disclosed dependence on the known drought year.
economic_promote_for_later_validation: At least 5% primary MAE improvement, nonnegative improvement in at least two of three score years and no improvement confined to 2022. These are proposed research-priority rules, not significance or investment thresholds. Otherwise report negative/fragile/inconclusive.
confounders: Grain export demand and harvest season
Fuel/barging capacity, dredging, closures and weather
High-water restrictions as well as low-water pressure
Revisions/datum changes, reporting schedule and changing quote construction
Price anticipation and researcher knowledge of drought episodes
inference: Descriptive forecast errors and coefficients, no causal identification, alpha test or promised power. No random-fold split or claim that raw weeks are independent.
exposure: ADM and Bunge are possible later commercial-exposure case studies; contracts, route shares, ownership and cost pass-through must be separately dated. No security, stock signal, holding period or trade selected.
stock_horizon: Not adopted. The economic forecast is one weekly quote ahead; this is not a 5-20-session equity holding rule.

future_source_check.scope: Publisher links/schema plus a handful of original stage and quote observations, no full panel until owner approval covers the conditional study. Use normal official current routes; stop on denial and do not bypass.
